facts.text: We told everyone we were off to Fiji. Now we're eating four Christmas dinners in one day, so pace yourself.
facts.why: They told their families they were going to Burma to inoculate babies, a charity trip. Fiji was their real plan. The line is also not film dialogue.
facts.fix: Use a note: Fiji is off, thanks to the fog. We are doing four Christmases in one day, so pace yourself.
